programs.title: Winchester
programs.desc: Inspired by true events. This is the most haunted house in the world, built by the heiress Sarah Winchester as an asylum for hundreds of vengeful ghosts with scores to settle.

programs.title: Superhost
programs.desc: Two travel vloggers check into a vacation rental with a host that will do anything for a good review.

programs.title: Buried
programs.desc: Beaten and buried in a wooden box by Iraqi insurgents, Paul Conroy is left with only a cell phone, a lighter and 90 minutes to save his own life.

programs.title: Righteous Kill
programs.desc: Two cops find themselves in pursuit of a serial killer who writes poems about the crime he just committed, leaving them at the scene.
